name: Skills Hub
headline: Skills Hub - Manage and Sync Agent Skills
short_description: Skills Hub is a cross-platform desktop app that manages Agent Skills in one place and syncs them to multiple AI coding tools' global directories. It simplifies skill management for operations teams by reducing manual updates and ensuring consistency across platforms.
author: qufei1993

sections.overview:
Skills Hub is a cross-platform desktop application designed to manage AI agent skills in a single location and automatically sync them to multiple AI coding tools' global directories. It streamlines the skill management workflow by eliminating manual updates across platforms and ensuring consistency in skill configuration. The application supports importing skills from curated repositories and features a built-in search capability for discovering and managing skills. Operations teams benefit from reduced manual overhead and improved skill consistency across their AI agent ecosystem. Skills Hub is built with Tauri and React, providing a modern interface for skill discovery, organization, and deployment.
Manage AI agent skills across Cursor, Claude Code, and other coding tools from one interface
Sync custom skills to multiple AI platforms without manual duplication
Discover and import skills from featured curated repositories
Maintain consistency of skill definitions across development teams
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/qufei1993/skills-hub`
sections.usage:
```
Create a new skill in Skills Hub for [TOOL_NAME] that automates [PROCESS_NAME]. The skill should include [SPECIFIC_TASKS] and be compatible with [PLATFORM_VERSION]. Ensure it follows the naming convention [NAME_CONVENTION] and includes error handling for [COMMON_ERRORS].
```
Copy

```
Skill Name: Data Backup Automation for CloudStorage Pro v2.0
Description: Automates daily backups of critical data to secure cloud storage, ensuring data integrity and availability.
Tasks:
1. Identify and compress files modified in the last 24 hours.
2. Encrypt the compressed files using AES-256 encryption.
3. Upload the encrypted files to the designated cloud storage bucket.
4. Verify the upload and send a confirmation email to the operations team.
Error Handling:
- If the cloud storage bucket is full, retry the upload after 5 minutes.
- If the encryption process fails, log the error and notify the system administrator.
Compatibility: CloudStorage Pro v2.0 and above.
Naming Convention: [Tool Name]_[Process Name]_[Version].
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
